text: Eating a balanced diet is the foundation of a healthy lifestyle. This means including plenty of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins in your meals, while limiting processed foods and added sugars. Alongside good nutrition, regular exercise—like brisk walking, cycling, or swimming—keeps your heart strong and your body flexible. Aim for at least thirty minutes of activity most days. Equally important is quality sleep; getting seven to nine hours each night allows your body to repair itself and improves your mood. Don’t forget mental health: practice relaxation techniques, such as deep breathing or mindfulness, to manage stress. Finally, a healthy work-life balance involves setting boundaries, taking breaks, and making time for hobbies and social connections. These habits together will help you feel energized and content.
